from solution import min_of_three
import inspect


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Example: assert min_of_three(10,20,0)==0."""
    expected = 0  # min(10, 20, 0) = 0
    assert min_of_three(10, 20, 0) == expected

    """Find minimum of three numbers."""
    expected = 1  # min(1, 5, 9) = 1
    assert min_of_three(1, 5, 9) == expected


def test_issue_second_is_minimum():
    """Find minimum of three numbers."""

    """Find minimum of three numbers."""
    expected = 1  # min(9, 5, 1) = 1
    assert min_of_three(9, 5, 1) == expected

    """Find minimum of three numbers."""

    assert min_of_three(7, 7, 7) == expected

    assert min_of_three(2, 2, 5) == expected

    """Find minimum of three numbers."""
    expected = -8  # min(-5, -2, -8) = -8
    assert min_of_three(-5, -2, -8) == expected

    """Find minimum of three numbers."""
    expected = 1.2  # min(1.5, 1.2, 1.8) = 1.2
    assert min_of_three(1.5, 1.2, 1.8) == expected


def test_issue_mixed_signs_around_zero():
    """Find minimum of three numbers."""
    expected = -1  # min(-1, 0, 1) = -1
    assert min_of_three(-1, 0, 1) == expected


def test_contract_callable():
    """Implement min_of_three(a, b, c) in solution.py."""

    assert callable(min_of_three) == expected


def test_contract_signature_params():
    """Implement min_of_three(a, b, c) in solution.py."""
    expected = ["a", "b", "c"]  # params are a, b, c in order
    assert list(inspect.signature(min_of_three).parameters) == expected


def test_contract_keyword_call():
    """Implement min_of_three(a, b, c) in solution.py."""
    expected = 2  # min(a=3, b=2, c=5) = 2
